ai_overview_references.title: The 50 Most-Cited Domains in Perplexity (September 2026). Opens in new tab.
Local AI Citations Study: Directories Win 36%, Businesses Get 7 .... Opens in new tab.

answer_text:
According to published research from September 2026, when Perplexity answered local business recommendation questions, third-party directories captured 36.2% of citations while local business websites captured 6.7% of citations. This specific analysis was published by NAP.biz in their Local AI Citations Study: Directories vs. Businesses.
If you meant the overall domain distribution across a broader set of prompts during that exact month, a massive study tracking 10.37 million citations from 57,327 prompts between September 1 and 28, 2026, was published by Surfer AI Search Analytics. They found that the top 50 most-cited websites accounted for only 9% of Perplexity's total citations, meaning 91% of citations went to a vast tail of niche-specific and local domains outside of the top 50.
